headline: Ramayana Day 20: ₹17.50 Cr India nett
lede: 13:00 IST: Ramayana Day 20: ₹17.50 Cr India nett
body:
## 13:00 IST — Occupancy and bookings

Through Day 20 the desk has Ramayana at ₹990.5 Cr India nett, ₹1,162.2 Cr India gross, ₹573.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,735.2 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹972.95 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, O.M Operation Mole at ₹5.40 Cr and Aakasamlo Oka Tara at ₹3.25 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. News18 is citing about ₹1,700.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹990.5 Cr India nett and ₹1,735.2 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.

editions.headline: Ramayana Day 20: ₹17.50 Cr India nett
editions.lede: Ramayana on Day 20 (Wednesday, 25 November 2026) is at ₹17.50 Cr India nett and ₹20.50 Cr India gross, +37.8% from Day 19's ₹12.70 Cr. The board has 15,817 shows at 28.1% occupancy. Trade notes mention advance bookings, but no separate booking total is published here. The day is still open, so this is not the final figure.
